name: ChainForensics
description: ChainForensics is a powerful, privacy-focused Bitcoin blockchain analysis tool that runs entirely on your own node. Analyze transactions, trace fund flows, detect CoinJoin transactions, and assess the privacy of your UTXOs - all without leaking any data to third parties.
short_desc: Privacy-focused Bitcoin blockchain analysis & UTXO privacy scoring
author: ChainForensics

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)

form_fields.label: Bitcoin Node Host / IP
form_fields.hint: Hostname or IP of your Bitcoin RPC node on the Runtipi network
